note: Description taken from Sands' 1965 description of the new species (in English); based on the soldier alone (the holotype is a soldier collected at Binda, São Tomé); alate and worker unknown. Sands notes that the species is very close to South American species and may have been introduced. The OCR misread decimal points as hyphens or colons (e.g. I-16 for 1.16, 0:35 for 0.35), restored here by magnitude; where a mean is illegible only the range is cited.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Body and head capsule (including the nasus) covered with long yellow bristles, unique among the Nasutitermes of the western Swedish region; very difficult to distinguish from the South American N. nigriceps, differing only in the paler colour; N. macrocephalus is larger and has scattered bristles on the postmental plate of the soldier.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule orange, nasus ferruginous orange; pronotum, antennae and abdominal tergites orange-yellow, sternites and legs yellow. Head capsule almost circular in frontal view, nasus conical; in lateral view wavy, with a distinct elevation at the base of the nasus and then rising swiftly and passing smoothly into the back of the head; nasus distinctly shorter than the rest of the head capsule measured from the posterior margin of the antennal bases, nasus cone angle 11—15 degrees; postmental plate moderately and evenly convex; antennae 13-segmented, III and V about equal, IV shorter than these two but slightly longer than II. Whole body and head capsule (including the nasus) covered with long yellow bristles, but those of the postmental plate confined to the anterior margin; bristles on the head capsule and nasus scattered, with no concentrated short bristles at the tip of the nasus; anterior margin of the pronotum with a row of prominent long bristles; bristles of the posterior sternite margins longer than the other abdominal bristles. Measurements (10 heads, taken at random from the type colony, mm): head length (to the tip of the nasus) 1.53—1.63 (mean 1.57); head width 0.95—1.03 (mean 0.99); head capsule depth 0.65—0.70 (mean 0.68); pronotum width 0.50—0.53 (mean 0.51); pronotum length 0.20—0.23 (mean 0.21); hind tibia length 1.25—1.38 (mean 1.30).
